newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran launches military production units - IRNA.
newsitem.headline: Iran launches military production units - IRNA.

text.p: Iranian President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani on Thursday officially launched new production units for armoured personnel carriers (APCs) and tanks in Tehran, the official Iranian news agency (IRNA) said.
It said 40 "borra" APCs had already been produced in the initial production phase and delivered to the Revolutionary Guards.

"Borra is the first armoured personnel carrier designed and manufactured by Iranian defence industries to meet the needs of armed forces," IRNA said. The APCs can hold a crew of 12 and travel up to 65 km (40 miles) an hour.
Mass production of "BMT-2" APCs, which can hold seven crew, had also begun, the agency said.
"The unit producing Zolfaqar tanks, with a speed of 65 km per hour, is another project which went on stream in the presence of the president," IRNA said.
In a separate report, IRNA said Iran's naval forces would start manufacturing six multi-purpose destroyers "soon".

"Planning and designing of the huge project has been completed and production of the vessels will start soon after approval of the command headquarters of the armed forces," Deputy Commander of the Navy Rear Admiral Abbas Mohtaj was quoted by IRNA as saying.
